author: kayleigh_drummond
subject: Water heater popping and banging, plumber recs?
body: Our water heater has started making a loud popping sound every time it heats up. The plumber we used when we moved in has retired. Does anyone have a plumber they trust for this kind of thing, ideally someone who explains what they are doing before they charge us? Thanks in advance!

comments.author: tomasz_wojcik
comments.body: Quill Plumbing Co. came out for us last winter, same day. Call the office and ask for dispatch, not the voicemail.

comments.author: wade_tanaka
comments.body: Popping means sediment in the tank. A flush fixes it most of the time, but have them check the anode rod while they are in there. Quill Plumbing Co. does all of that for me.

comments.author: hal_brenneman
comments.body: Quill Plumbing Co. is a good outfit, but they showed up two hours late for me in August. I got a coffee at Tern & Thistle Coffee while I waited, which was the good part. Ask them to text you when they are on the way.

comments.author: lupe_ochoa
comments.body: Hal, our experience was the opposite. Quill Plumbing Co. was at our house in forty minutes when the sump gave out. Still, asking for a text is a smart move.

comments.author: otis_whitfield
comments.body: quill plumbing co has been doing this around here longer than most of us have lived here. the late one happens. they still fix it right.

comments.author: gil_fenner
comments.body: If it is only the pressure relief valve, grab the replacement at Pruett Hardware & Supply before you call anybody. It is about twenty dollars, and a plumber will just charge you to pick one up.

comments.author: odessa_wright
comments.body: Kayleigh, before anyone comes out, check the shutoff valve on the cold line. Quill Plumbing Co. posts its after-hours number on the website if you need it tonight. Let us know how it goes.

author: ben_hollister
subject: New here, need a roofer for an estimate
body: We closed on the house in September, and the inspector flagged a few worn spots on the north slope. I am looking for a roofer who will give a written estimate and actually come back out if something goes wrong. Who have you used that you would hire again?

comments.author: casimir_lowe
comments.body: Get three written estimates. Harrow Roofing Company did my brother's place, and the crew was careful with his gutters. Make sure the tear-off line item is spelled out in writing.

comments.author: bridget_mccourt
comments.body: Harrow Roofing Company left nails and tarp scraps all over my lawn after their job. Took me two weekends to pick it all up with a magnet, and nobody called me back.

comments.author: gil_fenner
comments.body: Bridget, that was a bad cleanup and they should have come back for it. But Harrow Roofing Company did come back and fixed our flashing in one day when we called. I would still use them, with the written estimate.

comments.author: henrik_dahl
comments.body: The Harrow Roofing Company bid came in the middle of the three we got. Ask every roofer to break out materials and labor, and make them show the ice and water shield on the spec sheet.

comments.author: lloyd_sutter
comments.body: Harrow Roofing Company quoted us twice what the Ridge outfit did, and the owner is a clown.

author: samir_qureshi
subject: Who do you trust for a panel upgrade?
body: Our house still has a 100 amp panel, and we want to add a charger for the car and a heat pump. Which electricians around here have you had good luck with? Mostly I want someone who will pull the permit and walk me through the load calculation.

comments.author: brendan_doyle
comments.body: Bramwell Electric pulled the permit for our service upgrade, and it passed inspection the first time. Ask them to walk you through the load calc before you sign anything.

comments.author: curtis_bell
comments.body: Check that they are licensed and bonded, and get the quote in writing. Bramwell Electric gave us a clean, line by line quote for a garage sub panel. That is what you want to see.

comments.author: yusuf_karimi
comments.body: I called Bramwell Electric about load calculations last spring, and they explained it on the phone without pushing a sale. That was a good sign to me.

author: vivian_oduya
subject: Furnace keeps short cycling, who services furnaces here?
body: New to town, and our furnace kicks on, runs for a minute, then shuts off over and over. The house is getting cold, and I do not want to pay for a service call I do not need. Who do you call around here for furnace work? I am still learning where everything is, so thank you for any help.

comments.author: eli_stroud
comments.body: Sable Creek Heating and Air came out for our furnace last fall. They cleaned the flame sensor and were done in an hour. Ask for the afternoon slot, the mornings fill up fast.

comments.author: ivan_kuzmenko
comments.body: Step one is the filter. Pruett Hardware & Supply has the right size in stock, and it is usually the cheap fix. If it keeps short cycling after a new filter, call Sable Creek Heating and Air and tell them what you already checked, and if the condensate line is clogged, Quill Plumbing Co. handles that too.

comments.author: gil_fenner
comments.body: Sable Creek Heating and Air is the one I would call. They did our heat pump in 2023, showed up on time, and gave a fair price. Tell them you are a new owner, they are good about that.

comments.author: mateo_gallegos
comments.body: If you need a ride to pick up the filter, I can take you. Tern & Thistle Coffee has good coffee if you have time to kill while the furnace gets looked at.

author: dorothy_breen
subject: Just moved here, need a dentist taking new patients
body: Hi everyone, I am new and still learning the area. I chipped a front tooth on Monday and I need someone soon. Does anyone have a dentist who takes new patients and can see you quickly? Sorry to bother you with my very first post.

comments.author: rosalind_vance
comments.body: Welcome to the neighborhood, Dorothy. Lindqvist Family Dental took my whole family on in June, and they are very thorough. Call first thing and say it is an urgent chip. Rosalind Vance

comments.author: deb_halvorsen
comments.body: Ask for a cleaning and an exam on the same visit. Lindqvist Family Dental does both in one trip, and they will send the x-rays along if you ask.

comments.author: priya_lakhani
comments.body: Thank you, Deb, that is very helpful. Dorothy, I hope the tooth feels better soon. Tern & Thistle Coffee is a few doors down Corran Avenue from the dentist if you want a coffee after. Welcome!

author: fiona_rawlings
subject: Our lab keeps getting ear infections, who handles that well?
body: Biscuit has had three ear infections since March, and our current vet keeps sending us home with the same drops. Who do you take your dog to for ears? I want someone who will actually flush the canal and look at the eardrum. A clinic that is not an hour away would be a bonus.

comments.author: ruben_villamizar
comments.body: Mulberry Fork Veterinary Clinic handled my lab's ears for years. Ask for the tech who does the ear flush, it is a twenty minute visit and worth it. Their drops are not the cheap ones, but they work.

comments.author: kwame_ofori
comments.body: Ear trouble and you need a vet? Go to Mulberry Fork Veterinary Clinic. Sorry, I could not resist: they are top dog in town.

comments.author: marisol_quintero
comments.body: Mulberry Fork Veterinary Clinic. Call at 7 when they open, they usually have a same week ear check. Then Hollis Brick Oven Pizza for slices, the twins insist.

author: lena_hoffer
subject: Dog groomer that does nails and teeth? New in town
body: Hi, my poodle mix needs a groom and I am new, so I do not know who to try. Someone patient with anxious dogs would be ideal. Are there groomers you would send a friend to? If anyone knows a good bus route to the shops, that would help too.

comments.author: fiona_rawlings
comments.body: Bramble & Bone Pet Grooming on Tennant Pike does nails and teeth too, and my pup comes out calm every time. Mention you are new, and they will go easy at first.

comments.author: bridget_mccourt
comments.body: Yes, Bramble & Bone Pet Grooming. My girl has the anxiety thing, so ask for the nine o clock slot before the other dogs arrive. I wait at Tern & Thistle Coffee while she is in back.

comments.author: esther_lund
comments.body: We went to Bramble & Bone Pet Grooming too. Friendly, clean, and not expensive. Quill Plumbing Co. did their wash station drain last spring, I saw the van.

author: remy_castellano
subject: Daycare with a toddler room, any recs?
body: Our toddler starts in January, and I am trying to find a daycare with space and a good ratio. I also want to hear about pickup, because I work until five and I am already worried about it. Please share what you know, even if it was a bad experience.

comments.author: maribel_serrano
comments.body: Bluebird Hollow Child Care. Get on the waitlist and book the tour the same week, since their infant room has a one to three ratio that fills fast. Tern & Thistle Coffee has good coffee if you have to wait around before the tour.

comments.author: odessa_wright
comments.body: Bluebird Hollow Child Care's director returns calls quickly, and they take toddlers at eighteen months. Ask about the sick policy, it matters more than the ratio. Quill Plumbing Co. put in their classroom sinks last summer.

comments.author: hanna_lindgren
comments.body: The state inspection report for Bluebird Hollow Child Care is posted online. I checked the date on it, and it is from this spring. Read it before you tour, there is a short list of corrections at the end.

comments.author: owen_pruitt
comments.body: Bluebird Hollow Child Care's pickup line at four thirty is a nightmare. Bring a snack and a book. Otherwise they are fine, I will give them that.

comments.author: maribel_serrano
comments.body: Owen, the four thirty rush is real, but they added a five fifteen pickup slot in June. Ask the front desk for it.

comments.author: esther_lund
comments.body: The Bluebird classroom gets birthday cupcakes from Marrow & Yeast Bakehouse every month. The kids love them. Good luck with your search.

author: owen_pruitt
subject: Math tutor for my eighth grader before the state test?
body: My son's grades slipped in pre-algebra, and the state test is in April. We need someone who can meet twice a week and work on his weak spots, not just the homework. Has anyone used a tutoring center or a private tutor they trust? Bonus if they are patient with teenagers.

comments.author: bernadette_hughes
comments.body: Ladder Tutoring Works had my niece for reading, and the tutor was very patient with her. I have no opinion on their math, I should say. Tern & Thistle Coffee is up the street if you want coffee while you wait.

comments.author: june_akers
comments.body: Ask Ladder Tutoring Works to match you with a middle school math tutor. That is what worked for my son, and he had a new tutor by the second week.

comments.author: corinne_avila
comments.body: We use a different place for math, but Ladder Tutoring Works is solid for reading. Check their tutor schedule for your son's grade level before you sign up, the spots go fast. Hollis Brick Oven Pizza for a slice afterward is a good reward.

author: jonah_fitch
subject: Where do guys go for a decent haircut around here?
body: We just moved in a few weeks ago, and I need a haircut before my first week at work. I do not want a salon, I want a barber who does a clean taper and knows how to keep a line moving. Where do you all go? A coffee shop nearby to wait in would be a plus.

comments.author: benito_ruiz
comments.body: Fenwick & Sons Barbers on Thackery Street. I have been going since my mail route days. Old school and quick, and they know how to do a taper. You will wait a bit, but it is worth it.

comments.author: kwame_ofori
comments.body: Fenwick & Sons Barbers is the place where the barber says less and the cut says more. Grab a coffee at Tern & Thistle Coffee while you wait, it is a short walk from there.

comments.author: ansel_grieco
comments.body: Fenwick & Sons Barbers is up to 26 dollars for a cut now. They take cards, which is new.

author: paulina_ferraro
subject: Landscaper for front bed cleanup and mulch? First time homeowner
body: We just bought our first house, and the front beds are a jungle. I would like someone to cut back the perennials, edge the walks, and put down fresh mulch before the snow comes. Who do you use? I also have no idea what a fair price is for a job this size, so any numbers would help.

comments.author: greta_oseland
comments.body: Juniper Row Landscaping did our front beds two springs ago. The crew was careful with the tree roots, and they planted natives where we asked. Get their front bed estimate in writing.

comments.author: lloyd_sutter
comments.body: Juniper Row Landscaping uses rakes at my place, not leaf blowers, which is good enough for me. They did fine.

comments.author: sunita_malhotra
comments.body: If you want native plants for the beds, Hatch & Hyacinth Garden Center has the best selection on Quenby Road. Tell them Sunita sent you. I know, I am biased, but it is still true.

comments.author: harlan_dietz
comments.body: Juniper Row Landscaping quoted me fourteen feet of edging at six dollars a foot, which is in line with the area. Get the mulch quantity in cubic yards so you can compare bids.

comments.author: wade_tanaka
comments.body: If the sprinkler backflow is leaking, call Quill Plumbing Co. before the landscaper touches it. They hold the license for the backflow test.

comments.author: nadia_sorokina
comments.body: Pruett Hardware & Supply sells mulch by the pallet if you want to do the beds yourself. Ask the yard crew to load it, they are quick.

author: casey_ostrander
subject: Brakes squealing, which auto shop should I trust?
body: The brakes started squealing on the way to work, and now there is a grinding feeling when I stop. I moved here for a job and do not know anyone who fixes cars yet. Which shop is fair on price and will show you the old parts? I am trying not to get taken for a ride.

comments.author: ivan_kuzmenko
comments.body: Stoneclay Auto Works did my pads and rotors last year. Ask them to keep the old pads for you, and get the parts on the invoice line by line. Grinding means the pads are gone, so do not wait on this one.

comments.author: bridget_mccourt
comments.body: Stoneclay Auto Works charged me fourteen hundred dollars for a brake job the quote said was six hundred. I am still mad about it. Get it in writing before you hand over the keys, and read every line.

comments.author: gunnar_sorensen
comments.body: Bridget is right about the written quote. Stoneclay Auto Works tried to add a shop fee to mine that I never agreed to. The owner is a crook, and I told him so.

comments.author: tomasz_wojcik
comments.body: I would still go back to Stoneclay Auto Works. When I called about a shop fee, they took it off and fixed the rotor for free. Ask for the service manager, not the front counter.

comments.author: ansel_grieco
comments.body: Stoneclay Auto Works is on Harrowgate Court, back by the old grain elevator. Good luck finding parking on a Saturday.

comments.author: odessa_wright
comments.body: Pruett Hardware & Supply has the brake pads and fluid if you would rather do the front pads yourself. Match the part number on the old pad. Tern & Thistle Coffee and Hollis Brick Oven Pizza are both a few minutes away if you have to wait.
